verdict.rationale: sevDesk's own docs say you can invite your tax advisor to collaborate in your sevdesk account, with secure access to receipts, reports and tax-related settings. That covers inviting an external accountant. Role-scoped permissions and the advisor's ability to adjust bookings are not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: documented role/permission scoping for invited users, explicit edit or adjust-entries rights for the accountant, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books
